confidence_notes: Restaurant price estimates are supported by 2026 city-level data, though mid-range meal figures vary. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation figures are holistic July high-season estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used; restaurant estimates are Bruges-specific, while accommodation estimates reflect Bruges's high-season tourism profile and similar historic tourist cities in Flanders.
